mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, check how I feel, and sit on the edge of the bed before standing. Wash up and get dressed for the studio.
mara.intention: Return to the day without rushing my recovery.

mara.activity: Review planting plans and answer early work messages at the office desk, marking the items that need attention in the studio.
mara.intention: Start with a contained review rather than letting the client work sprawl across the morning.

mara.activity: Pack my work things, drink more water, and leave for the studio and site visits. Place my keys deliberately in the open entryway while I put on my shoes.
mara.intention: Leave the house organized enough to come back to calmly.

mara.activity: Work at the studio, attend site visits, and handle client meetings and planting-plan revisions.
mara.intention: Be present and exacting without spending all of my energy on revisions that can wait.

mara.activity: Come home, remove my shoes, put the keys in the kitchen island area, and place my field notebook on the living room sideboard countertop before changing course for the evening.
mara.intention: Make the transition from work visible and uncomplicated.

mara.activity: Make a quick plate of toast and scrambled eggs at the kitchen island, eating before class rather than trying to cook a full dinner afterward.
mara.intention: Keep myself fed while making room for the new class.

mara.activity: Rinse the plate and skillet, wipe the island, and gather what I need before walking to ceramics class.
mara.intention: Leave the kitchen usable and go out before I can talk myself out of being a beginner.

mara.activity: Attend my first ceramics class, working with clay and allowing the forms to remain imperfect while I learn.
mara.intention: Practice concentration that does not have to produce a client-ready result, and enjoy a separate social world.

mara.activity: Return home, make ginger tea, and have a small second helping of toast if I am hungry. If the chef friend is here, join the lively conversation for a while while noticing when professional talk starts to fill the room.
mara.intention: Be welcoming without giving the whole evening back to work talk.

mara.activity: Straighten the kitchen quietly, rinse the mug and plate, and put my ceramics things together for the next class rather than leaving them scattered.
mara.intention: Set a gentle boundary around the day and preserve the pleasure of having begun something new.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into sleep pants and a sleep shirt, and put my phone on its charger.
mara.intention: Wind down without checking work again.

mara.activity: Get into bed, place my reading glasses on top of the nightstand, read a few pages, and turn out the light.
mara.intention: End the first ceramics day quietly and protect tomorrow’s energy.
Rest fully after the first full workday back.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and lie still for a few minutes while checking how I feel and whether she is resting comfortably.
julian.intention: Start gently and preserve a little quiet before the workday.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in work trousers, a restaurant shirt, wool socks, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Wake up properly and get ready without rushing.

julian.activity: Make coffee and a small breakfast, carry them to the kitchen island, and eat while listening to a few quiet minutes of piano music.
julian.intention: Keep the familiar morning rhythm, with something substantial enough for prep.

julian.activity: Pack my backpack, fill the thermos, collect my keys from the piano middle shelf, and leave for the restaurant.
julian.intention: Leave with the essentials and avoid the usual last-minute scramble.

julian.activity: Handle deliveries, prep, stock checks, and kitchen management at the restaurant, keeping a detailed list for anything that needs follow-up.
julian.intention: Get the kitchen organized early so the evening service has room for the unexpected.

julian.activity: Travel home, bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, put my backpack by the island, and leave my restaurant notebook on the island with receipts tucked inside.
julian.intention: Make a clean handoff from work to home without pretending I have endless energy.

julian.activity: Eat a small portion of leftovers or yogurt and fruit, drink water, and sit quietly in the main bedroom to reset before returning to work.
julian.intention: Recover rather than filling the break with chores or screens.

julian.activity: Review the service notes, change into a clean chef jacket and apron, and send Mara a short practical message before leaving.
julian.intention: Prepare for service and let Mara know I am looking forward to seeing her later without adding pressure.

julian.activity: Collect my backpack and keys and travel back to the restaurant.
julian.intention: Arrive with a few minutes to spare.

julian.activity: Run dinner service and closing duties, staying focused through the rush and finishing the kitchen properly.
julian.intention: Protect the quality of the service while keeping enough attention in reserve for the evening at home.

julian.activity: Travel home with my chef friend, bring the thermos into the kitchen, drop my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table, and put my backpack near the island.
julian.intention: Let the visit happen naturally while making a little space for it in the house.

julian.activity: Sit with my chef friend and Mara for a brief, lively decompression; talk about service, mistakes, and the class with shy enthusiasm, while keeping the conversation from becoming an endless shop meeting.
julian.intention: Enjoy being understood by another chef and include Mara without asking her to perform professionally.

julian.activity: Put out a simple snack and water for the conversation, then carry the used dishes to the kitchen and leave them by the sink.
julian.intention: Feed everyone something small without starting another full cooking project.

julian.activity: Say goodnight to my friend, take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and change into sleep clothes without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Close the day with the familiar quiet routine after an unusually social night.

julian.activity: Drink water, put my phone on its charger, retrieve my wallet and earplugs from the living room coffee table, and put them in my pockets for the morning.
julian.intention: Do only the necessary reset before bed.

julian.activity: Get into bed beside Mara and settle into sleep.
julian.intention: Rest fully after the long service and the unexpectedly warm visit.
